title: ConductorQueueEntry
description: Schema for a single entry in session_queue.yaml. Validated by validate_queue.py before every Conductor run.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for this queue entry. Format: <phase>-<sub-session> e.g. 4C-1-S1, SMOKE-S0, 4C-3.

brief_path.description: Relative path (from worktree root) to the CLAUDECODE_BRIEF for this session.

branch.description: Git branch the sub-agent works on.

worktree_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the git worktree the sub-agent operates in.

depends_on.description: List of session_ids that must have status: passed or status: skipped before this entry is eligible.

requires_external_gate.description: Name of a gate defined in the external_gates block, or null if no external gate.

requires_brief_authoring.description: If true, the brief at brief_path does not yet exist. Conductor halts with failure_class: requires_brief_authoring before attempting to run.

requires_human_approval.description: If true, Conductor always halts before executing this entry, regardless of gate state.

push_to_remote.description: If true, the sub-agent is permitted to push to remote after completing its work.

gate_command.description: Shell command run by the orchestrator after sub-agent completes. Must exit 0 for PASS. Empty string means no gate.

expected_artifacts.description: Informational list of file paths expected to exist after the sub-agent runs. Not machine-validated — for human review.

est_tokens.description: Estimated token budget for the sub-agent context. Informational only.

est_duration_min.description: Estimated wall-clock duration in minutes. Informational only.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this queue entry.

human_decision_prompt.description: Text shown to the user when this entry triggers a human-approval halt. null if requires_human_approval is false.
